title: Rename a function across a small project
instruction:
Rename the function calc_price to compute_price everywhere in this project: its definition, every call, imports, docstrings, comments, the README and the tests. Behaviour must not change.

Only the exact name calc_price changes. Other names that merely contain the text, such as recalc_price_cache, must keep their current names. After the change, the old name must not appear anywhere as a standalone word. Update the tests so they still pass.
